Container.Name: V-Rising
Container.Overview:
V Rising dedicated server.
V Rising ships no Linux server binary, so this pulls the Windows depot with SteamCMD and runs it under GE-Proton, the same way the ARK: Survival Ascended container here does. First boot downloads about 2GB and then builds a Proton prefix, which can sit quiet for several minutes before anything appears in the log. That is normal.
Settings here are applied on every restart, so changing Max Players or the password and restarting takes effect. They are passed to the server as launch options rather than written into its config files, which means your own edits to ServerHostSettings.json and ServerGameSettings.json are never overwritten - the container seeds those two files once from the defaults the server ships with and then leaves them alone forever.
Anything not listed as a field below is still reachable: the server reads its own VR_ environment variables, so adding a variable named VR_FPS with a value of 45 sets the server framerate, and every setting in Stunlock's documentation works the same way. See https://github.com/StunlockStudios/vrising-dedicated-server-instructions for the full list.
The server saves when the container stops. Raise Unraid's own container stop timeout to at least 75 seconds so the save is not cut off.

Container.Changes:
###1.0.0 (2026-09-07) Initial release.
- V Rising dedicated server. The game ships no Linux server binary, so this installs the Windows depot with SteamCMD and runs it under GE-Proton. - Settings here are applied as launch options on every start, so changing Max Players or the password and restarting takes effect. They are not written into the server's config files, so your own edits to ServerHostSettings.json and ServerGameSettings.json are never overwritten. - Any variable you add whose name starts with VR_ is read by the server directly, so every setting in Stunlock's documentation is available even without a field for it. For example VR_FPS set to 45. - Stopping the container saves the world. Raise Unraid's container stop timeout to at least 75 seconds. - A CPU without AVX is handled automatically.
Container.Requires: About 4GB once installed - 1.6GB of server files, 2.1GB for the GE-Proton build and its wine prefix - so allow 6GB of free space for saves and updates. It is not a light server, so give it several GB of RAM. The array is fine; a cache drive or SSD makes world loads and saves noticeably quicker.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Game traffic. UDP. This is the one to forward. To change it, set the Container Port, the Host Port and Server Port below all to the same number - Docker cannot tell the server what its host port is, so the three have to agree for the log to report the port players actually type. If you also run the ARK: Survival Ascended container on this server, its Query Port defaults to 27015 as well and Docker will refuse to start the second container. Change one of them - ARK's is the safer one to move, since its 27015 is vestigial and discovery goes via EOS.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: The port the server binds. Keep it equal to Game Port above, both the Container Port and the Host Port.

Config.Name: Query Port
Config.Description: Steam server list traffic. Forward this too, or the server runs fine and never appears in the browser.

Config.Name: Server Query Port
Config.Description: The query port the server binds. Keep it equal to Query Port above, both the Container Port and the Host Port.

Config.Name: RCON Port
Config.Description: RCON. Only forward this if you administer the server from outside this box - anyone who reaches it and has the admin password controls the server.

Config.Name: Server RCON Port
Config.Description: The RCON port the server binds. Keep it equal to RCON Port above.

Config.Name: Game Files
Config.Description: Where the server, saves and settings live. Several GB - see Requires below.

Config.Name: SteamCMD
Config.Description: SteamCMD itself. Small, and shareable with other SteamCMD containers.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name shown in the server browser. Applied on every restart.

Config.Name: Save Name
Config.Description: Name of the save directory. Changing this after first boot starts a NEW world - the old one stays on disk under save-data/Saves and can be switched back to by setting this name again. It does not rename anything.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Player slots. 128 is the documented maximum. Applied on every restart.

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Join password. Leave blank for an open server. Applied on every restart.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: RCON password. Leaving this blank disables RCON entirely, which is the safe default - the server still saves and shuts down cleanly without it. Set it only if you want to run admin commands.

Config.Name: Server Description
Config.Description: Shown in the server browser's details panel, and printed in chat as players connect.

Config.Name: Max Admins
Config.Description: Admins allowed to connect even when the server is full.

Config.Name: Game Settings Preset
Config.Description: Load one of the presets shipped in VRisingServer_Data/StreamingAssets/GameSettingPresets, e.g. StandardPvP. Blank uses ServerGameSettings.json as it stands.

Config.Name: Difficulty Preset
Config.Description: Difficulty_Easy, Difficulty_Normal or Difficulty_Brutal. Blank leaves the setting alone.

Config.Name: List on Steam
Config.Description: Register on the Steam server list. true or false.

Config.Name: List on EOS
Config.Description: Register on the EOS server list, which is where the client looks by default. true or false.

Config.Name: Secure Mode
Config.Description: VAC protection. VAC banned clients cannot connect. true or false.

Config.Name: Extra Game Parameters
Config.Description: Appended to the launch line verbatim. Most settings do not need this - see the Overview about VR_ variables.

Config.Name: Validate Files
Config.Description: Set to true to have SteamCMD verify every file on the next start. Slow. Use it after a crash or a failed update.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Turns on Proton and wine logging. Noisy and slows startup - use it when the server exits without writing any log of its own.

Config.Name: Proton Version
Config.Description: GE-Proton build to run the server under. This image is tested against GE-Proton10-34. A build the game does not tolerate fails silently, before any log is written - if that happens, set this back and delete the proton folder so the prefix is rebuilt.

Config.Name: Stop Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a graceful save-and-exit before force killing. Also raise Unraid's own container stop timeout to match.

Config.Name: Steam Username
Config.Description: Leave blank. The V Rising server downloads anonymously.

Config.Name: Steam Password
Config.Description: Leave blank.

Config.Name: UID
Config.Description: User ID. 99 is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: GID
Config.Description: Group ID. 100 is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: Data Permissions
Config.Description: Mode applied to the top of the server directory.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask for files the server creates. 000 keeps them editable over the share.
